ingredients.description: Argan Oil is an antioxidant and emollient. Lip Benefits: Rich in fatty acids and vitamin e, it deeply hydrates dry, chapped lips. Helps soothe cracked lips and promotes faster healing. Improves lip texture, making them feel softer and more supple.
ingredients.name: Argania Spinosa Kernal Oil
Hippophae Rhamnoides (Sea Buckthorn) Oil
ingredients.description: Sea Buckthorn Oil is an antioxidant and an emollient. Lip Benefits: Packed with omega fatty acids (3, 6, 7, and 9) that nourish and lock in moisture. Rich in vitamins A, C, and E, it promotes skin repair and soothes irritation. The high vitamin C content helps improve lip elasticity and plumpness. Reduces redness, irritation, and sensitivity, making it great for dry or sensitive lips.

ingredients.name: Brassica Napus Seed Oil
ingredients.description: Rapeseed Oil is an emollient. We wanted to incorperate an emollient into our lip serum that is super sensitive but also helps lock in moisture. Lip Benefits: It's high in essential fatty acids (Like omega-3 and omega-6), which help lock in moisture and prevent dryness and chapping. It gives lips a natural, healthy sheen without needing synthetic glosses.

ingredients.name: Cera alba
ingredients.description: Beeswax *ethically sourced* is an emollient and thickening agent helping the formulation appear thicker. Lip Benefits: Beeswaxs helps lock in moisture, keeping lips hydrated and preventing dryness or chapping. Rich in vitamin A, it supports skin cell regeneration, which can help maintain soft and healthy lips. Beeswax contains anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties that can help heal cracked or irritated lips.
